## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

List the checks and manual tests performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and preserves existing local functionality.
- [ ] I added or updated proportionate validation.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff for credentials, personal information, local
      paths, private recordings or transcripts, generated files, and session notes.
- [ ] I updated documentation and third-party notices where behavior, dependencies,
      attribution, or licensing changed.
- [ ] I preserved Windows and Linux behavior or clearly documented a platform limit.
- [ ] I did not include downloaded models, recordings, logs, or build artifacts.
